title: Environment Variables module didn't work with Administrator right
author: stEve0x33

status.label: Likely covered by the title-bar startup guard
status.detail: The attached diagnostics point at a Microsoft.UI.Windowing startup failure in the elevated Environment Variables window, and current main already contains an Environment Variables-specific empty-title guard in that path.

next_action.label: Ask for a retest on a build with the guard
next_action.reason: Current source already contains a targeted startup hardening change for the same Environment Variables title-bar path.

judgment.rationale: The uploaded diagnostics show PowerToys.EnvironmentVariables.exe faulting in Microsoft.UI.Windowing.dll during startup, which matches the title-bar initialization path that current main already hardens for Environment Variables in PR #49069. The public issue does not show a post-fix retest yet.
evidence: The issue says the Environment Variables window opens as a blank black window and closes only when the administrator option is enabled.
The reporter replied to a /bugreport request with a diagnostic ZIP.
The uploaded Event Viewer XML shows PowerToys.EnvironmentVariables.exe faulting in Microsoft.UI.Windowing.dll with exception code e0464645.

Current src/modules/EnvironmentVariables/EnvironmentVariables/EnvironmentVariablesXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cs contains an explicit non-empty title fallback, and file history shows that hardening landed in PR #49069.
judgment.recommended_action: Point maintainers and the reporter to the existing title-bar startup guard and ask for confirmation on a build that contains it.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current source tree already contains a targeted Environment Variables startup hardening change in the reported window-construction path.

issue_context.summary: Environment Variables closes immediately only when elevated. The attached diagnostics point at a Microsoft.UI.Windowing startup fault, and current main already carries an Environment Variables title-bar guard for that initialization path.
known_information: The reporter is on PowerToys 0.100.2 from GitHub on Windows 25H2 build 26200.8973.
Normal launch works; enabling the administrator option makes the window open blank and close after one to three seconds.
A maintainer requested /bugreport, and the reporter uploaded a PowerToysReport ZIP.
The issue has Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, Needs-Team-Response, and Product-Environment Variables labels with no assignee.
inferences: The failure likely occurs during elevated WinUI window startup rather than deeper Environment Variables business logic, because the window never becomes interactive.
The Event Viewer module and current source change both point at the title-bar / window-title initialization path.
issue_context.analysis: Current main already hardens the exact Environment Variables startup path implicated by the bugreport. The maintainer-facing action is to connect this report to that fix path and seek a current-build confirmation rather than creating a second speculative design.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body, both comments, labels, assignees, and attachments.
Downloaded and unpacked the uploaded bug-report ZIP and inspected EventViewer-PowerToys.EnvironmentVariables.exe.xml, which records a Microsoft.UI.Windowing.dll startup fault.
Inspected EnvironmentVariablesXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cs and its file history, which shows the non-empty title fallback added in PR #49069 specifically to protect this startup path.

actions.label: Ask for retest with the title-bar guard build

comment.body: Thanks for uploading the diagnostic ZIP. The crash event in PowerToys.EnvironmentVariables.exe points at Microsoft.UI.Windowing.dll during startup, and current main already has an Environment Variables title-bar guard from #49069 for this window-construction path. Please retest with a build that includes that change and confirm whether the elevated launch still opens as a blank black window and closes immediately.
